entry.name: mc.times~
entry.description: *~ is a signal multiplier-operator that outputs a signal which is the multiplication between two signals.

arguments.name: initial-multiplier
arguments.description: Sets an initial value by which to multiply the signal coming into the left inlet. If a signal is connected to the right inlet, the argument is ignored. If no argument is present, and no signal is connected to the right inlet, the initial value isby default.

messages.name: float
messages.description: In left inlet: A factor by which to multiply the signal coming into the right inlet. If a signal is connected to both left and right inlets, aorconnected to either inlet will be ignored.In right inlet: A factor by which to multiply the signal coming into the left inlet. If a signal is connected to both left and right inlets, aorconnected to either inlet will be ignored.

messages.name: int
messages.description: In left inlet: A factor by which to multiply the signal coming into the right inlet. If a signal is connected to both left and right inlets, aorconnected to either inlet will be ignored.In right inlet: A factor by which to multiply the signal coming into the left inlet. If a signal is connected to both left and right inlets, aorconnected to either inlet will be ignored.

messages.name: signal
messages.description: In left inlet: The signal is multiplied by the signal coming into the right inlet, or a constant value received in the right inlet. All signal inputs to a single inlet are summed. If a signal and number are both sent to the left inlet, the specified operation will be performed with those values.In right inlet: The signal is multiplied by the signal coming into the left inlet, or a constant value received in the left inlet. All signal inputs to a single inlet are summed.
